tools.name: plan_trips
tools.description: Generate cheap round trips through several cities, from cached flights. Accepts one departure city (from) or up to 5 (from_cities); with several, a trip can return to a different one of them. Returns trips sorted by total price. To share or book a trip, pass its flight_ids to save_trip.

tools.name: save_trip
tools.description: Save a trip from flight ids returned by search_flights or plan_trips. Returns a public page with the trip and a booking link on Kiwi.com. Prices are confirmed on the booking site.

tools.name: search_cities
tools.description: Find city names we have flights for. Use the exact name in the other tools.

tools.name: search_flights
tools.description: Cheapest one-way flights between two cities, or from one city to anywhere, from cached airline prices. Dates are a departure window.
